issues.claim: Fowler considers the choice between weak and collective ownership a matter of the team's social dynamics and says both work.
issues.problem: The page says 'Both seem to work, and fail, equally well'. Dropping the 'and fail' part makes the source sound more positive than it is. The RU text 'обе модели работают' has the same omission.
issues.suggestedFix: EN: 'and says both work, and fail, about equally well'. RU: 'и что обе модели одинаково хорошо работают и одинаково часто дают сбои'.
